deliberateDepartures: The common light palette replaces the examples’ cream paper, graphite, and terracotta palette; white notebook paper and faint border-colored rules retain the construction tone.
Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif replaces the samples’ Latin handwriting fonts as required. Labels remain upright to protect Japanese readability.
Hatching is sparse and kept outside label areas; waiting panels use dashed contours and explicit status text rather than treating waiting as failure.
Outputs use the target slot dimensions directly; the enclosing placement-frame title and evaluation caption are not duplicated outside the SVG.
No dark outputs, external references, supplied example composition facts, or optional ornamental stages were added.
